source_title: The Godhead Equation That Made Money Real
summary: This December 2024 Civilization lecture is the direct Godhead/monotheism source already powering the public Power As Alchemy symbols-become-reality anchor: Jiang turns Nicaea, orthodoxy, and the Godhead formula into a model for how non-debatable symbols become reality, then routes capitalism, science, and the nation-state through that conversion.

existing_lens_links.rationale: Power As Alchemy owns the symbol-to-reality conversion. The episode read and public page already expose the durable anchor, so no episode JSON repair is needed.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The public Power page already uses this source for Godhead-as-equation, symbols becoming reality, money as nothing/everything, and capitalism/science/nation-state as modern reality forms.
existing_lens_links.rationale: This impact decision accounts for already-public evidence pressure rather than proposing a new ordinary append to a page that is near the replacement/compression watch band.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: preserve this 2024-12-28 lecture as the earliest direct Godhead-theological grammar for Power As Alchemy, where a closed formula makes symbols more than representations and lets money, science, and nation-state identity become lived reality.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns the symbol-to-reality conversion. Religion owns the office/trust-code machinery; Legitimacy Fiction owns imperial authorization; Eschatology owns final-order scripts; Nation owns the sacred national body; Dead World owns material-only ontology and science as reality foreclosure.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold for later comparison: Paul's church scales by fitting Roman household hierarchy, centralizing interpretation in bishops, and turning aristocratic conversion into network conversion.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Religion As Administrative Filter owns this only when the active object is institutional selection, trusted interpretation, and office discipline. Power owns the later symbolic conversion; Legitimacy Fiction owns ruler authorization.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold Constantine as kingly religion-making evidence: after civil war, the ruler introduces a religion and orthodoxy to unify the empire and consolidate authority.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Legitimacy Fiction owns the ruler-authorizing story and imperial settlement. Religion owns the administrative church form; Power owns the symbol-reality grammar produced by the settlement.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the science/objectivity close only after comparison: Jiang says premodern imagination could hold layered realities, while science class acts like a religion that blocks other realities and teaches objectivity as truth.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Dead World owns material-only reality foreclosure. Reason As Replacement Religion owns the atlas relation when science, objectivity, and progress inherit sacred authority.

new_lens_seeds.title: Monotheism As Abstraction Engine
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A nonlocal, singular, non-debatable Godhead trains people to treat symbols as reality, crowd out competing worlds, and obey abstractions such as money, science, capitalism, and the nation-state.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism recurs across Power, Religion, Legitimacy Fiction, Nation, Eschatology, Dead World, and Reason As Replacement Religion, but it should not become a public page until later religion sources prove a narrower portable mechanism rather than a topic umbrella.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create standalone Monotheism, Godhead Equation, Christianity, Paul, Constantine, Orthodoxy, Science Religion, or Nation-State-As-God pages from this source alone.

atlas_mutations.current_structure: Power As Alchemy already carries the public symbol-to-reality anchor; the atlas also has Reason As Replacement Religion as a relation and separate public pages for Religion, Eschatology, Nation, Dead World, and Legitimacy Fiction.
atlas_mutations.proposed_mutation: No public atlas mutation now. Keep Monotheism As Abstraction Engine as a routing seed and use this impact file as the source-backed first promotion condition.
atlas_mutations.reason: The source is strong enough to pressure the map, but the just-reviewed boundary decision says the pressure still splits by active object. More impact accounting is needed before a child page or atlas relation can serve readers better than existing boundaries.

chronology_notes.note: This 2024-12-28 lecture is earlier than the 2025-08-21 Power Is Alchemy course-opening source and is the earlier direct Godhead/symbol-reality formulation for the public Power anchor.

The close explicitly points to later classes for objectivity and collective-hallucination development, so science/reality claims should be compared before public Dead World or Reason-religion expansion.
